phases.note: Two constants: MAX_DRAWDOWN 0.25 (real money), DEV_MAX_DRAWDOWN 0.50 (dev screen), read at the four decision sites dev.FAILURE_LABELS/dev.make_row/store.owner_failures/store._blocking. Engine 4757 passed 4 skipped; ruff clean; web tsc clean + 685 passed/49 files. lab.sqlite byte-identical, test_looks 4, no row edited. MEASURED before/after on the landed tree, matching reconciliation exactly: dev-eligible 26 trials/16 methods -> 67/32; browsable 93/37 -> 319/76; at a 0.25 screen 60/30; 0.40 and 0.50 identical at 67/32. HELD_OUT_BY_THE_TRADES_BAR 5 -> 12, and 0 of the 12 clear the luck bar, so design 13's finding survives. DECISIONS: SUPERSEDED_BARS={0.20} not the plan's {0.15,0.20} (rung 1, invariant 9 - excusing 0.15 deletes the sibling guard's live coverage); drawdown label stays bound to dev.FAILURE_LABELS[1] since that tuple is import-time and the monkeypatch cannot reach it (rung 2); _ballast default fall 0.245->0.55 (it went silently eligible under the looser screen); lib/sera/lab.test.ts drawdown equality re-expressed as a one-way implication plus a non-vacuity check, since D12 forbids adding gate.devMaxDrawdown (rung 1, invariant 9). DRIFT: five web test files beyond the plan's three-file web scope (commit ab4fe01); and 'lab stage' run bare stages the MAIN checkout because the venv's editable install resolves there - needs PYTHONPATH=engine/src. Main checkout verified clean.
